user_review.method: Current maintainer review from the published entry point; instruction scenarios are simulated, and actual local tool checks are labeled executed. Earlier evidence is listed separately.

scenarios.request: Could a fresh machine take over this repo? Just check the existing files.
scenarios.expected: Provide evidence-based readiness gaps without changing the repo.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough finds an obsolete setup link, missing next task and undocumented check; preview explicitly excludes bootstrap execution, cleanup, upload and tags.

scenarios.request: The branch has local work and tests are already failing. Is it ready to hand off?
scenarios.expected: Report the checked revision and missing proof without beginning the close.
scenarios.observed: Read-only preview can report the dirty checkout and failed suite; full close and shed-only still fail closed. No independent reader or bootstrapped takeover is claimed.

scenarios.request: Clean up the superseded tracked and untracked paths.
scenarios.expected: Show complete inventory and await exact approval, then treat the two types differently.
scenarios.observed: Reviewed the preserved shed-only route: tracked files use Git recovery and untracked files go to quarantine after approval. No deletion was executed.
